title.en: Volume 380 Biographies 167: Chen Ruolin, Dai Sanxi, Sun Erzhun, Cheng Zuluo, Ma Jisheng, Yu Tai, He Zhangling
title.raw: 卷380 列傳一百六十七 陈若霖 戴三锡 孙尔准 程祖洛 马济胜 裕泰 贺长龄

sentences.zh: 列傳一百六十七

translations.literal: Biographies 167
translations.idiomatic: Biography 167

sentences.zh: 陳若霖戴三錫孫爾準程祖洛馬濟勝裕泰賀長齡

translations.literal: Chen Ruolin, Dai Sanxi, Sun Erzhun, Cheng Zuluo, Ma Jisheng, Yu Tai, He Zhangling
translations.idiomatic: Chen Ruolin, Dai Sanxi, Sun Erzhun, Cheng Zuluo, Ma Jisheng, Yu Tai, and He Zhangling

sentences.zh: 陳若霖，字宗覲，福建閩縣人。

translations.literal: Chen Ruolin, styled Zongqin, was a man of Min County, Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Ruolin, whose style was Zongqin, came from Min County in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十二年進士，選庶吉士，散館授刑部主事，累遷郎中。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year of Qianlong he became a jinshi, was chosen as a Hanlin bachelor, and upon leaving the academy was appointed a principal secretary in the Ministry of Punishments; he was promoted in succession to bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fifty-second year of the Qianlong reign (1787), entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and after completing his academy term was posted to the Ministry of Punishments as a principal secretary, rising in due course to bureau director.

sentences.zh: 束鹿縣民王洪中為人聚毆，訟不得直，自經死。

translations.literal: Wang Hongzhong, a commoner of Shulu County, was set upon and beaten by a crowd; he could not obtain justice in his suit and hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hongzhong, a commoner of Shulu County, was beaten by a mob; unable to win redress in court, he took his own life by hanging.

sentences.zh: 若霖鞫得其實，被議敘。

translations.literal: Ruolin examined the case and established the facts; he was entered in the merit review.
translations.idiomatic: Ruolin investigated the case, established what had actually happened, and was recorded for merit in the official review.

sentences.zh: 秩滿當外用，仍留部。

translations.literal: When his term was complete he ought to have been posted outside the capital, but he remained at the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: When his term expired he should have received an outside appointment, yet he was kept on at the ministry.

sentences.zh: 數從大臣赴各省讞獄，以寬恕稱。

translations.literal: He several times accompanied high ministers to re-examine capital cases in the provinces and was known for clemency.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly accompanied senior officials on provincial tours to re-examine serious criminal cases and earned a reputation for leniency.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十三年，出為四川鹽茶道，擢山東按察使。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Jiaqing he went out as salt controller of the Sichuan circuit and was promoted to surveillance commissioner of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of the Jiaqing reign (1808) he left the capital as Sichuan salt controller and was promoted to surveillance commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 調廣東，署布政使，以佐總督百齡平海盜，賜花翎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Guangdong as acting financial commissioner; for assisting Governor-General Bai Ling in pacifying sea pirates he was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Guangdong as acting financial commissioner, he aided Governor-General Bai Ling in suppressing piracy at sea and was awarded the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 調湖北，復調四川，就遷布政使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Hubei, then again to Sichuan, where he was promoted in place to financial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: After postings in Hubei and then Sichuan again, he was promoted on the spot to financial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二十年，擢雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was promoted to governor of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of Jiaqing (1815) he was appointed governor of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 水尾土州目黃金珠結內地奸民，殺副州目李文政，掠其家，鞫實，置於法。

translations.literal: Huang Jinzhu, native chieftain of Shuwei Tuzhou, joined with scoundrels from the interior, killed Vice-Chieftain Li Wenzheng, and plundered his household; the facts were established on investigation and he was punished by law.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Jinzhu, the native chieftain of Shuwei Tuzhou, colluded with ruffians from the interior, murdered Vice-Chieftain Li Wenzheng, and looted his family; once the facts were proved in court, he was executed according to law.

sentences.zh: 歷廣東、河南、浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: He served in succession as governor of Guangdong, Henan, and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He went on to govern Guangdong, Henan, and Zhejiang in turn.

sentences.zh: 浙省南北新關科罰無度，限以半正額為止，卹商而課裕。

translations.literal: In Zhejiang the northern and southern Xinguan customs posts levied fines without limit; he capped them at half the regular quota, showing mercy to merchants while keeping revenue ample.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhejiang's northern and southern Xinguan customs posts, fines had been levied without restraint; he limited them to half the regular quota, easing the burden on merchants while keeping the tax yield healthy.

sentences.zh: 修蕭山新廟堤，建盤頭以御潮。

translations.literal: He repaired the Xinmiao embankment at Xiaoshan and built a headwork to withstand the tide.
translations.idiomatic: He repaired the Xinmiao dike at Xiaoshan and built a headwork to hold back the tide.

sentences.zh: 次年，新林塘圮，親往勘，疏言：「新林塘舊為險工，今距海日遠，塘以外為灶地，外復為牧地，中有馬塘，足為新林屏蔽，宜補築以遏潮汐。

translations.literal: The next year the Xinlin embankment collapsed; he went in person to inspect it and memorialized: 'The Xinlin embankment was formerly a critical work; now the distance to the sea grows daily. Beyond the embankment are salt-pan lands, and beyond those pasture lands; between them is Mataang, which can serve as a screen for Xinlin. It should be repaired to check the tidal bore.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the Xinlin seawall gave way; he inspected the site himself and memorialized: "The Xinlin dike was once a critical floodwork, but the shoreline has been receding. Beyond the dike lie salt evaporation pans, and beyond those grazing lands; Mataang Pond in between can shield Xinlin. The dike should be rebuilt to hold back the tides.

sentences.zh: 疏通灶地各溝洫，引入牧地之莫家等灣以排泄之，即以灶地之土培護新林堤基。

translations.literal: He proposed to clear the ditches of the salt-pan lands and lead the water into bays such as Mojia in the pasture lands for drainage, using soil from the salt pans to strengthen the base of the Xinlin dike.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed clearing the drainage channels through the salt pans and directing the water into bays such as Mojia on the pasture side for discharge, using earth from the pans to buttress the Xinlin dike foundation.

sentences.zh: 西築橫塘以御江水。

translations.literal: To the west he would build a transverse embankment to hold back river water.
translations.idiomatic: To the west, a cross-dike should be built to hold back the river.

sentences.zh: 責令灶牧各戶及蕭山、山陰、會稽三縣，分別修築。」

translations.literal: He ordered the salt-pan and pasture households and the three counties of Xiaoshan, Shanyin, and Kuaiji each to undertake repairs as assigned.'
translations.idiomatic: He assigned the salt-pan and pasture households and the counties of Xiaoshan, Shanyin, and Kuaiji to carry out the repairs in their respective sectors."

sentences.zh: 又奏修會稽、上虞等縣塘堤，並如議行。

translations.literal: He also memorialized to repair the embankments of Kuaiji, Shangyu, and other counties, and all was carried out as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized for repairs to the seawalls of Kuaiji, Shangyu, and other counties, and everything was implemented as he had proposed.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，擢湖廣總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was promoted to governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year of Jiaqing (1819) he was appointed governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 湖南鳳凰等廳屯丁額多為官佔，失業者眾，悉清釐發還徵租。

translations.literal: In Hunan, at Fenghuang and other garrisons, much of the military colonists' quota had been seized by officials, leaving many without livelihood; he cleared the accounts entirely and restored the land for rent collection.
translations.idiomatic: In Hunan, at Fenghuang and other military colonies, much of the settlers' allotted land had been appropriated by officials, leaving many without livelihood; he cleared the records completely and restored the plots so rents could be collected again.

sentences.zh: 官入苗寨多婪索，或冒名詐財，嚴禁之。

translations.literal: When officials entered Miao stockades they often extorted greedily or falsely assumed names to defraud for money; he strictly forbade this.
translations.idiomatic: Officials entering Miao villages often extorted bribes or used false names to swindle money; he strictly prohibited such conduct.

sentences.zh: 又以屯地磽瘠租額重，為奏減苗租二萬餘石，免逋賦七萬餘石，苗民感之。

translations.literal: Because the colony lands were poor and barren yet the rent quotas were heavy, he memorialized to reduce Miao rents by more than twenty thousand piculs and remit more than seventy thousand piculs of arrears; the Miao people were grateful.
translations.idiomatic: Finding the colony lands barren while rent quotas remained heavy, he memorialized to cut Miao rents by more than twenty thousand piculs and to remit over seventy thousand piculs in arrears, winning the gratitude of the Miao people.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，調四川。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he was transferred to Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Daoguang reign (1822) he was transferred to Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 中江覃萬典、犍為道士蕭來修等假神惑眾，捕誅首犯，不坐株連。

translations.literal: Tan Wandian of Zhongjiang and the Daoist Xiao Laixiu of Qianwei and others feigned divine powers to mislead the masses; the ringleaders were arrested and executed without extending guilt by association.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Wandian of Zhongjiang and the Daoist priest Xiao Laixiu of Qianwei, among others, pretended supernatural powers to delude the people; the leaders were arrested and put to death without punishing their followers by association.

sentences.zh: 九姓長官司不諳吏治，奏請考試，獄訟別由瀘州及州判兼理。

translations.literal: The Nine-Surname Headmen's Office was unversed in civil administration; he memorialized for examinations, with lawsuits handled separately by Luzhou and the subprefectural judge.
translations.idiomatic: The chieftain's office of the Nine Surnames was unversed in regular administration; he memorialized that its officers should be examined, with legal cases handled separately by Luzhou and the subprefectural judge.

sentences.zh: 四年，召授工部尚書，調刑部，兼管順天府尹事。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was summoned and appointed minister of Works, transferred to Punishments, and concurrently directed the affairs of the Shuntian prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Daoguang (1824) he was recalled to the capital as minister of Works, transferred to the Ministry of Punishments, and given concurrent charge of the Shuntian metropolitan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 文安縣地形如釜底，自道光初堤防衝決，積水不能耕種，議請急行修築。

translations.literal: Wen'an County's terrain was like the bottom of a cauldron; from the beginning of Daoguang the dikes had been breached and water stood so that fields could not be cultivated; he proposed urgent repairs.
translations.idiomatic: Wen'an County lies in a basin-like depression; since the start of the Daoguang reign its dikes had been breached and fields lay under standing water; he urged that repairs be undertaken at once.

sentences.zh: 七年，命勘湖北京山黃家陵堤工，疏言：「下游災民籥請修治潰堤，上游居民謂口門下游乃襄河故道，復請廢之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was ordered to inspect the Huangjialing embankment works at Jingshan in Hubei and memorialized: 'Downstream disaster victims urgently petitioned to repair the breached dike; upstream residents said the outlet downstream was the old course of the Xiang River and again petitioned to abandon it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1827) he was ordered to inspect the Huangjialing dike at Jingshan in Hubei and wrote: "Downstream flood victims pleaded urgently for the breached dike to be repaired, while upstream residents claimed the breach outlet led to the old bed of the Xiang River and petitioned again to leave it open.

sentences.zh: 河流經行二百餘年，捨此不由，而別尋二百年以前故道，其說殊謬。

translations.literal: The river has followed its present course for more than two hundred years; to abandon this and seek instead a channel from two hundred years ago is utterly mistaken.
translations.idiomatic: The river has run along its present course for more than two hundred years; to abandon it and hunt for a channel from two centuries ago is utterly absurd.

sentences.zh: 潛江、天門、漢川俱屬下游，而天門、漢川尤當衝要，何忍委之巨浸？

translations.literal: Qianjiang, Tianmen, and Hanchuan all lie downstream, and Tianmen and Hanchuan are especially critical points—how can we bear to abandon them to vast inundation?
translations.idiomatic: Qianjiang, Tianmen, and Hanchuan all lie downstream, and Tianmen and Hanchuan are especially exposed—how could we abandon them to deep floodwaters?

sentences.zh: 惟有開通江流，堵合口門，因勢利導。

translations.literal: The only course is to open the river's flow, close the breach outlet, and guide the water according to its natural tendency.
translations.idiomatic: The only course is to clear the river channel, close the breach, and guide the current along its natural course.

sentences.zh: 胡家灣沙洲當下游之衝，以四十餘丈之地束全江之水，下壅上潰，理有必然。

translations.literal: The sandbar at Hujiawan lies directly in the downstream current; to confine the whole river within a width of forty-odd zhang inevitably causes backing up below and bursting above.
translations.idiomatic: The sandbar at Hujiawan sits squarely in the downstream current; squeezing the entire river into a channel barely forty zhang wide will inevitably dam the flow below and force breaches above.

sentences.zh: 今洲已衝潰，乘勢挑濬新灘，展寬水道，使江流無衝突之患，然後增築京山、鍾祥口門堤壩，再於潰口築石壩二，以護堤攻沙，庶可經久。」

translations.literal: Now that the bar has been washed away, we should take advantage of the situation to dredge a new channel and widen the waterway so the river has no conflict of currents; then strengthen the outlet dikes at Jingshan and Zhongxiang, and build two stone dams at the breach to protect the dikes and scour away sand—only then can the works endure.'
translations.idiomatic: Now that the bar has been washed out, we should seize the moment to dredge a new channel and widen the waterway so the river flows without conflict; then raise the outlet dikes at Jingshan and Zhongxiang and build two stone dams at the breach to shield the dikes and scour away silt—only then can the works last."

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: His report was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 十二年，乞休歸，卒於途，賜卹。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he requested retirement and set out for home; he died on the road and posthumous favors were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year (1832) he asked to retire and started for home, but died on the journey; the court granted funeral honors.

sentences.zh: 戴三錫，順天大興人，原籍江蘇丹徒。

translations.literal: Dai Sanxi was a man of Daxing, Shuntian, with original domicile in Dantu, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Sanxi was registered in Daxing, Shuntian, though his ancestral home was Dantu in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十八年進士，授山西臨縣知縣。

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year of Qianlong he became a jinshi and was appointed magistrate of Lin County, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi of the fifty-eighth year of Qianlong (1793), he was appointed magistrate of Lin County in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 連丁父母憂，嘉慶六年，服闋，發四川，補南充。

translations.literal: He twice observed mourning for his parents; in the sixth year of Jiaqing, when mourning ended, he was sent to Sichuan and appointed to Nanchong.
translations.idiomatic: He twice went into mourning for his parents; when the second mourning period ended in the sixth year of Jiaqing (1801), he was posted to Sichuan and assigned to Nanchong.

sentences.zh: 歷馬邊、瓘邊兩廳通判，署資州、眉州、卭州，並有政聲。

translations.literal: He served as subprefect of Mabian and Guanbian departments and as acting prefect of Zizhou, Meizhou, and Qiongzhou, winning a reputation for good government at each post.
translations.idiomatic: He served as subprefect of the Mabian and Guanbian departments and as acting prefect of Zizhou, Meizhou, and Qiongzhou, earning a reputation for sound administration at every post.

sentences.zh: 卭州民黃子賢以治病為名，倡立鴻鈞教，捕治之。

translations.literal: Huang Zixian of Qiongzhou, under the pretext of healing, founded the Hongjun sect; Sanxi arrested and punished him.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Zixian of Qiongzhou had founded the Hongjun sect under the guise of healing; Sanxi arrested and punished him.

sentences.zh: 事聞，仁宗命送部引見，擢茂州直隸州知州。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, Emperor Renzong ordered him sent to the ministry for imperial audience and promoted him to magistrate of Maozhou directly under the province.
translations.idiomatic: When the case was reported, the Jiaqing Emperor ordered him brought to the capital for audience and promoted him to magistrate of Maozhou.

sentences.zh: 歷寧遠知府、建昌道、四川按察使。

translations.literal: He served in succession as prefect of Ningyuan, intendant of Jianchang circuit, and surveillance commissioner of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the posts of prefect of Ningyuan, intendant of Jianchang circuit, and surveillance commissioner of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，遷江寧布政使，迴避本籍，仍調四川。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he was moved to financial commissioner of Jiangning, but to avoid his native place was transferred back to Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daoguang (1822) he was appointed financial commissioner of Jiangning, but because that was his home province he was transferred back to Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 三年，署總督，五年，實授，兼署成都將軍。

translations.literal: In the third year he acted as governor-general; in the fifth year he received the substantive appointment and concurrently acted as Chengdu general.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1823) he served as acting governor-general; in the fifth year (1825) he received the full appointment and concurrently acted as General of Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 三錫自牧令洊陟封疆，二十餘年，未離蜀地。

translations.literal: Sanxi rose from magistrate and prefect step by step to frontier governor; for more than twenty years he never left Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Sanxi had risen from county and prefectural posts to a frontier governorship, and for more than twenty years he never left Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 盡心民事，興復通省書院，增設義學三千餘所。

translations.literal: He devoted himself to the people's affairs, restored academies throughout the province, and added more than three thousand charity schools.
translations.idiomatic: He devoted himself to civil administration, restored provincial academies, and established more than three thousand charity schools.

sentences.zh: 四川舊有義田，積儲備賑，穀多則變價添置良田。

translations.literal: Sichuan had long maintained charity fields, storing grain for relief; when grain was abundant it was sold and the proceeds used to buy more fertile land.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan had long maintained charity fields whose grain reserves were kept for famine relief; when stores grew large, grain was sold and the proceeds used to buy better farmland.

sentences.zh: 三錫以歲久將膏腴多成官產，留穀太多，又虞霉變虧挪，差定三千至萬石為額。

translations.literal: Sanxi, because over the years much fertile land had become government property, too much grain was being retained, and there was fear of mold and embezzlement, fixed a quota of three thousand to ten thousand piculs.
translations.idiomatic: Sanxi found that over the years much of the best land had passed into government hands, reserves had grown excessive, and grain risked spoilage and embezzlement; he fixed a quota of between three thousand and ten thousand piculs per fund.

sentences.zh: 溢額者出糶，價存司庫，以備兇歲賑恤之用。

translations.literal: Surplus above the quota was sold off, the proceeds kept in the provincial treasury for use in famine years for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Any surplus above the quota was sold, with the proceeds held in the provincial treasury for relief in years of dearth.

sentences.zh: 又以蜀地惟成都附近俱平疇沃野，餘多山谷磽瘠，遇水沖塞，膏腴轉為砂石，因地制宜，多設渠堰，以資捍衛宣洩。

translations.literal: He also noted that in Shu only the vicinity of Chengdu was level fertile plain; elsewhere were mostly barren hills and valleys where floodwaters deposited silt and fertile soil turned to sand and stone; adapting to local conditions, he built many canals and weirs for defense and drainage.
translations.idiomatic: He also observed that only the Chengdu plain was level and fertile, while most of the province was hilly and poor, with floods depositing silt until good land turned to gravel; accordingly he built canals and weirs suited to each locality for protection and drainage.

sentences.zh: 新都奸民楊守一倡立邪教，造妖書惑眾，擒誅之。

translations.literal: The scoundrel Yang Shouyi of Xindu founded a heterodox sect and produced demon writings to delude the masses; he was seized and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Shouyi, a ruffian of Xindu, founded a heterodox sect and wrote seditious tracts to mislead the people; Sanxi had him arrested and executed.

sentences.zh: 越巂生番劫奪商旅，掠漢民婦女，捕駔黠者數十人置之法，救出被掠男婦，給貲安撫。

translations.literal: Raw tribesmen of Yuexi robbed merchants and travelers and carried off Han women; several dozen of the craftiest ringleaders were arrested and punished by law, and the abducted men and women were rescued and given funds for resettlement.
translations.idiomatic: Raw tribesmen of Yuexi had been robbing merchants and abducting Han women; Sanxi arrested several dozen of the ringleaders and punished them by law, rescued the captives, and provided funds to settle them.

sentences.zh: 屢被詔褒獎。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly commended by imperial edict.
translations.idiomatic: He received repeated imperial commendations.

sentences.zh: 九年，因年老召來京，署工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, because of age he was summoned to the capital and appointed acting vice minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Daoguang (1829), owing to his age he was recalled to the capital and appointed acting vice minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 尋致仕，未幾，卒。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he retired; before long he died.
translations.idiomatic: He soon retired from office and died not long after.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其「宣力有年，官聲素好」，贈尚書銜，依贈銜賜卹。

translations.literal: An edict praised him: 'For years he has exerted his strength; his official reputation has long been good,' and granted him the honorary rank of minister, with funeral favors according to that rank.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised him for "many years of devoted service and a consistently good official reputation," conferred the honorary rank of minister, and granted funeral honors appropriate to that rank.

sentences.zh: 孫爾準，字平叔，江蘇金匱人，廣西巡撫永清子。

translations.literal: Sun Erzhun, styled Pingshu, was a man of Jin'gui, Jiangsu, and son of Yongqing, governor of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Erzhun, whose style was Pingshu, came from Jin'gui in Jiangsu and was the son of Yongqing, governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Jiaqing he became a jinshi, was chosen as a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed reviser.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi of the tenth year of Jiaqing (1805), he entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor and was appointed reviser.

sentences.zh: 十九年，出為福建汀州知府。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he went out as prefect of Tingzhou, Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Jiaqing (1814) he was appointed prefect of Tingzhou in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 寧化民斂錢集會，大吏將治以叛逆。

translations.literal: The people of Ninghua collected money for gatherings; high officials were about to treat them as rebels.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Ninghua had been pooling money for communal gatherings, and senior officials were preparing to prosecute them for treason.

sentences.zh: 爾準訊無他狀，論誅首要，鮮所株連。

translations.literal: Erzhun examined the case and found no other circumstances; he sentenced only the ringleaders to death, with few implicated by association.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhun investigated and found no treasonous intent; he punished only the ringleaders, with scarcely anyone else implicated.

sentences.zh: 歷鹽法道、江西按察使，調福建，就遷布政使。

translations.literal: He served as salt controller, surveillance commissioner of Jiangxi, was transferred to Fujian, and was promoted in place to financial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He served as salt controller and surveillance commissioner of Jiangxi, was transferred to Fujian, and was promoted on the spot to financial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，調廣東布政使，擢安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he was transferred to financial commissioner of Guangdong and promoted to governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daoguang (1821) he was transferred to financial commissioner of Guangdong and then appointed governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 河南邪匪邢名章等糾眾竄潁州，檄按察使惠顯率兵馳剿，格殺名章，殲其餘黨。

translations.literal: The heterodox bandit Xing Mingzhang of Henan and others gathered a mob and fled into Yingzhou; Erzhun ordered Surveillance Commissioner Hui Xian to lead troops in rapid pursuit, killed Mingzhang in combat, and wiped out the rest of the band.
translations.idiomatic: The heterodox leader Xing Mingzhang of Henan rallied followers and fled into Yingzhou; Erzhun dispatched Surveillance Commissioner Hui Xian with troops in pursuit, killed Mingzhang in battle, and destroyed the remaining band.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩被災各屬，災甚者賑恤之。

translations.literal: He remitted or deferred taxes in all disaster-stricken districts and gave relief where the damage was severe.
translations.idiomatic: He remitted or deferred taxes in all stricken districts and provided relief where the damage was worst.

sentences.zh: 先是有言賑務積弊，毋得以銀折錢，爾準疏其弗便，仍循舊章。

translations.literal: Earlier there had been proposals that relief work had long-standing abuses and that silver must not be converted to cash; Erzhun memorialized that this would be inconvenient and continued under the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier reformers had argued that relief operations were riddled with abuse and that silver payments must not be converted to copper cash; Erzhun memorialized that this would be impracticable and continued under the established rules.

sentences.zh: 三年，調福建巡撫。

translations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to governor of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Daoguang (1823) he was appointed governor of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 延、建各屬山徑叢錯，多盜劫，以萬金為緝捕費，連獲賊首置之法，盜風衰息。

translations.literal: In Yanzhou and Jianning circuits the mountain paths were tangled and banditry was rife; he allocated ten thousand taels for pursuit and capture, seized bandit chiefs in succession and punished them by law, and the plague of robbery subsided.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yanzhou and Jianning districts the mountain paths were tangled and banditry rampant; he allocated ten thousand taels for pursuit, captured successive ringleaders and punished them by law, and robbery subsided.

sentences.zh: 巡閱台灣，疏言：「台灣南北袤延千餘裡，初抵鹿耳門，可行舟楫。

translations.literal: On an inspection tour of Taiwan he memorialized: 'Taiwan extends more than a thousand li from north to south; on first arrival one reaches Lu'ermen, where boats and oars can navigate.
translations.idiomatic: On an inspection tour of Taiwan he wrote: "Taiwan stretches more than a thousand li from north to south. Ships first reach Lu'ermen, where vessels can navigate freely.

sentences.zh: 嗣增設鹿仔港，而淺狹多沙，內山溪水赴海，別開港在嘉彰間，曰五條港，頗利商船。

translations.literal: Later Luzai Harbor was added, but it is shallow, narrow, and sandy; mountain streams from the interior reach the sea, and another port was opened between Jia and Zhang, called Wutiao Harbor, which greatly benefits merchant shipping.
translations.idiomatic: Later Luzai Harbor was opened, but it is shallow, narrow, and sandy. Streams from the interior mountains reach the sea, and another port was opened between Jia and Zhang, called Wutiao Harbor, which serves merchant shipping well.

sentences.zh: 又噶瑪蘭山峻路險，負戴難行，其地有烏石港、加禮遠港，可通五六百石小舟，皆宜設為正口。」

translations.literal: Moreover, in Gamelan the mountains are steep and the roads perilous, making porterage difficult; there are Wushi Harbor and Jialiyuan Harbor, which can accommodate small boats of five or six hundred piculs—all suitable to be established as official ports.'
translations.idiomatic: In Gamelan the mountains are steep and the roads dangerous, making overland transport arduous; Wushi Harbor and Jialiyuan Harbor there can accommodate small vessels of five or six hundred piculs capacity—all should be designated official ports."

sentences.zh: 五年，擢閩浙總督。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Daoguang (1825) he was appointed governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 奏請噶瑪蘭收入版藉，設官治理。

translations.literal: He memorialized to bring Gamelan under the civil register and establish official governance.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to bring Gamelan under civil administration and establish regular government there.

sentences.zh: 彰化匪徒械鬥焚劫，旁近蜂起，全台震動，檄水師提督許松年剿捕，副將邵永福等趨艋舺，阻其北竄；

translations.literal: Bandits in Zhanghua fought with weapons, burned, and plundered; neighboring areas rose in swarms and all Taiwan was shaken; he ordered Naval Commander Xu Songnian to suppress and capture them, while Brigadier Shao Yongfu and others hastened to Mengjia to block their flight north;
translations.idiomatic: Ruffians in Zhanghua rioted with arms, burning and looting; neighboring districts erupted and all Taiwan was shaken. Erzhun ordered Naval Commander Xu Songnian to suppress them, while Brigadier Shao Yongfu and others rushed to Mengjia to block their escape north;

sentences.zh: 總兵陳化成以兵渡鹿仔，防其入海。

translations.literal: Major General Chen Huacheng crossed with troops at Luzai to prevent their escape to sea.
translations.idiomatic: Major General Chen Huacheng crossed at Luzai with troops to keep them from fleeing by sea.

sentences.zh: 爾準親駐廈門，遣副將佟樞等分往彰化、淡水，搜山圍捕，诇知賊黨煽誘日眾，移陸路提督馬濟勝守廈門，自渡海駐彰化督剿，賊首李通遁，捕得伏誅。

translations.literal: Erzhun personally stationed at Xiamen and sent Brigadiers Tong Shu and others separately to Zhanghua and Danshui to search the hills and encircle the bandits; learning that rebel agitation was growing daily, he shifted Land Forces Commander Ma Jisheng to guard Xiamen, crossed the strait himself to station at Zhanghua and direct the campaign, the bandit chief Li Tong fled but was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhun took personal command at Xiamen and sent Brigadier Tong Shu and others to Zhanghua and Danshui to sweep the hills and encircle the rebels. Learning that agitation was spreading daily, he left Land Forces Commander Ma Jisheng to hold Xiamen, crossed to Zhanghua himself to direct operations, and though the rebel leader Li Tong initially escaped, he was eventually captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 令各莊舉首事，緝餘匪，閩人捕閩人，粵人捕粵人，以免誣累。

translations.literal: He ordered each village to elect headmen to pursue the remaining bandits—Fujianese to catch Fujianese, Cantonese to catch Cantonese—to avoid false accusations.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered each village to elect headmen to hunt down remaining rebels—Fujian natives to arrest Fujian natives, Cantonese to arrest Cantonese—so that innocent people would not be swept up.

sentences.zh: 台人有與生番貿易遂娶番婦者，俗名「番割」，其魁黃斗乃等久踞三灣，潛出為盜。

translations.literal: Some Taiwanese who traded with raw tribesmen and then married tribal women were popularly called 'Fan-ge'; their leader Huang Dounai and others had long occupied Sanwan and secretly came out to rob.
translations.idiomatic: Some Taiwanese who traded with raw tribesmen and married tribal women were known as "Fan-ge." Their leader Huang Dounai and his followers had long held Sanwan and raided the countryside in secret.

sentences.zh: 當亂起時，誘生番出山助鬥，遣參將黃其漢等分路偵擊。

translations.literal: When the disturbance broke out they incited raw tribesmen to come out of the mountains and join the fighting; he sent Colonel Huang Qihan and others on separate routes to scout and strike.
translations.idiomatic: When the uprising broke out they incited raw tribesmen to join the fighting; Erzhun sent Colonel Huang Qihan and others along separate routes to scout and attack.

sentences.zh: 番竄後山，士卒攀藤躡葛而登，擒黃斗乃等二十一人，斬以徇。

translations.literal: The tribesmen fled to the rear mountains; soldiers climbed by grasping vines and treading creepers, captured Huang Dounai and twenty others, and beheaded them as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: The tribesmen fled into the rear mountains; soldiers climbed by vine and creeper, captured Huang Dounai and twenty others, and beheaded them as a public warning.

sentences.zh: 爾準疏陳匪徒起事，由於造謠焚掠，非叛逆，當以強盜論；

translations.literal: Erzhun memorialized that the bandits' rising arose from rumor-mongering and burning and plundering, not rebellion, and should be treated as brigandage;
translations.idiomatic: Erzhun memorialized that the outbreak arose from rumor-mongering, arson, and looting rather than rebellion, and should be prosecuted as brigandage;

sentences.zh: 淡水以北分黨報復，當以械鬥論；

translations.literal: north of Danshui the factions took revenge on one another and should be treated as armed affray;
translations.idiomatic: north of Danshui, where factions took revenge on one another, the cases should be treated as armed affray;

sentences.zh: 焚殺有據者始坐闢，餘俱末減。

translations.literal: only those with proven arson and killing were sentenced to execution; the rest received reduced penalties.
translations.idiomatic: only those with proven arson and murder were sentenced to execution, while the rest received reduced sentences.

sentences.zh: 其脅從旋解散者，多所保全。

translations.literal: Many of those coerced who soon dispersed were preserved.
translations.idiomatic: Many who had been coerced and soon dispersed were spared.

sentences.zh: 又奏台灣北路至艋舺幾五百里，僅有守備一員，巡防難週。

translations.literal: He also memorialized that from northern Taiwan to Mengjia was nearly five hundred li, yet there was only one garrison commandant, making patrol coverage difficult.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized that the northern Taiwan route to Mengjia ran nearly five hundred li, yet only one garrison commandant was stationed there, making patrol coverage impossible.

sentences.zh: 調南路游擊一員駐竹塹，並於大甲、銅鑼灣、鬥換坪諸處添駐營汛，改建淡水土城。

translations.literal: He transferred a brigade commander from the southern route to station at Zhuqian, added garrison posts at Dajia, Tongluowan, Douhuanping, and other places, and rebuilt the earthen wall at Danshui.
translations.idiomatic: He transferred a brigade commander from the southern route to Zhuqian, added garrison posts at Dajia, Tongluowan, Douhuanping, and other points, and rebuilt the earthen fort at Danshui.

sentences.zh: 頭道溪為生番出入總路，亦建土城，以屯丁駐守。

translations.literal: Toudao Stream was the main route by which raw tribesmen came and went; there too he built an earthen fort garrisoned by military colonists.
translations.idiomatic: Toudao Stream was the main route by which raw tribesmen entered and left; there too he built an earthen fort manned by military colonists.

sentences.zh: 事平，加太子少保。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When order was restored he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 七年，入覲，宣宗嘉其治台灣匪亂悉合機宜，迅速蕆功，賜其子慧翼官主事。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he came to court for audience; Emperor Xuanzong praised his handling of the Taiwan bandit disturbance as entirely appropriate, with rapid completion of the task, and granted his son Huiyi the office of principal secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1827) he came to the capital for audience; the Daoguang Emperor praised his handling of the Taiwan disturbances as entirely apt and swiftly concluded, and granted his son Huiyi the rank of principal secretary.

sentences.zh: 木蘭陂者，創自宋熙寧間，溉民田四十萬畝，築石堤千一百餘丈以御海潮，歲久傾壞，爾準道經莆田，親勘修復。

translations.literal: The Mulan embankment was first created in the Xining era of Song, irrigating four hundred thousand mu of farmland; a stone dike more than eleven hundred zhang long was built to withstand the sea tide; after years it had collapsed, and when Erzhun passed through Putian on official business he inspected and restored it in person.
translations.idiomatic: The Mulan Barrage, first built in the Xining era of the Song, irrigated four hundred thousand mu of farmland behind a stone dike more than eleven hundred zhang long to hold back the tide. After centuries of decay, Erzhun inspected the site in person when passing through Putian and oversaw its restoration.

sentences.zh: 工蕆，以宋長樂室女錢創陂實功首，建祠列入祀典。

translations.literal: When the work was completed, because Qian, a maiden of Changle in Song, had been the first to fund the barrage's creation, a shrine was built and she was entered in the sacrificial register.
translations.idiomatic: When the work was finished, he built a shrine to Qian, the maiden of Changle who had first funded the barrage in Song times, and entered her in the official register of sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 爾準治閩最久，諳悉其風土人情，吏民皆相習，政從寬大，閩人安之。

translations.literal: Erzhun governed Fujian longest, was thoroughly versed in its customs and human relations, officials and people were all accustomed to him, his administration was lenient and broad, and the people of Fujian were at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhun governed Fujian longer than any other post; he knew its customs and people intimately, officials and commoners alike were accustomed to him, his rule was lenient, and the Fujianese were content.

sentences.zh: 九年，坐失察家僕收賄，鐫二級留任。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was demoted two ranks and retained in office for failure to detect that his household servant had taken bribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year (1829) he was demoted two ranks but kept in office for failing to detect that a household servant had accepted bribes.

sentences.zh: 十一年，以病乞休。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he requested retirement on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1831) he asked to retire on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 逾年，卒，贈太子太師，賜子慧惇進士，慧翼員外郎，諡文靖，祀福建名宦及鄉賢祠。

translations.literal: The next year he died; he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent; his son Huidun was granted jinshi status, Huiyi the rank of bureau director, his posthumous title Wenjing, and he was enshrined in Fujian's halls of eminent officials and local worthies.
translations.idiomatic: He died the following year. The court posthumously made him Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, granted his son Huidun jinshi status and Huiyi the rank of bureau director, gave him the posthumous title Wenjing, and enshrined him in Fujian's halls of eminent officials and local worthies.

sentences.zh: 程祖洛，安徽歙縣人。

translations.literal: Cheng Zuluo was a man of She County, Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Zuluo came from She County in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年進士，授刑部主事，洊遷郎中。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he became a jinshi, was appointed a principal secretary in the Ministry of Punishments, and was promoted in succession to bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi of the fourth year of Jiaqing (1799), he was appointed a principal secretary in the Ministry of Punishments and rose in due course to bureau director.

sentences.zh: 諳練刑名，為仁宗所知。

translations.literal: He was thoroughly versed in penal law and came to the notice of Emperor Renzong.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled in penal law, he won the notice of the Jiaqing Emperor.

sentences.zh: 京察記名道府，久未外簡，以截取銓授甘肅平涼知府。

translations.literal: In the capital evaluation he was noted for circuit and prefectural posts, but for long received no outside appointment; through the special selection he was assigned as prefect of Pingliang, Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Marked in the capital evaluation for circuit and prefectural promotion, he waited long for an outside posting until a special selection assigned him prefect of Pingliang in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 部臣請留，詔斥規避邊遠，撤銷記名，留部永不外用。

translations.literal: Ministry officials requested that he be kept; an edict rebuked him for shunning the frontier, revoked his noted name, and kept him at the ministry never to serve outside again.
translations.idiomatic: When ministry officials asked to retain him, an edict rebuked him for evading a frontier post, struck his name from the promotion list, and ordered him kept at the ministry with no further outside appointment.

sentences.zh: 久之，擢內閣學士。

translations.literal: After a long while he was promoted to Academician of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: After a long interval he was promoted to Academician of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 尋授江西按察使，遷湖南布政使，調山東。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed surveillance commissioner of Jiangxi, moved to financial commissioner of Hunan, and transferred to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed surveillance commissioner of Jiangxi, then financial commissioner of Hunan, and transferred to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，擢陝西巡撫，調河南。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he was promoted to governor of Shaanxi and transferred to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daoguang (1822) he was appointed governor of Shaanxi and then transferred to Henan.

sentences.zh: 教匪硃麻子由新蔡竄安徽阜陽，捕獲置之法。

translations.literal: The sect bandit Zhuma-zi fled from Xincai into Fuyang, Anhui; he was captured and punished by law.
translations.idiomatic: The sect rebel known as Zhuma-zi fled from Xincai into Fuyang in Anhui; Zuluo captured him and had him executed.

sentences.zh: 與直隸、山東、安徽、湖北毗連諸縣素多盜，撥庫帑五萬兩生息，為緝捕經費。

translations.literal: The counties bordering Zhili, Shandong, Anhui, and Hubei had long been rife with bandits; he allocated fifty thousand taels from the treasury to earn interest as funds for pursuit and capture.
translations.idiomatic: The counties bordering Zhili, Shandong, Anhui, and Hubei had long been plagued by banditry; he set aside fifty thousand taels from the treasury to earn interest as a standing fund for pursuit and capture.

sentences.zh: 漳水決安陽樊馬坊，河流北徙，命大學士戴均元往會勘。

translations.literal: The Zhang River broke through at Fanmafang in Anyang and shifted north; Grand Secretary Dai Junyuan was ordered to go and inspect jointly.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhang River burst its banks at Fanmafang in Anyang and shifted northward, Grand Secretary Dai Junyuan was ordered to inspect the site jointly with him.

sentences.zh: 祖洛週曆上下游，合疏言：「漳水自乾隆五十九年南徙合洹以來，衛水為所遏，每致潰溢。

translations.literal: Zuluo toured the upper and lower reaches and jointly memorialized: 'Since the Zhang River shifted south and joined the Huan in the fifty-ninth year of Qianlong, the Wei River has been blocked and breaches and overflows occur repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: Zuluo surveyed the upper and lower reaches and jointly memorialized: "Since the Zhang River shifted south to join the Huan in the fifty-ninth year of Qianlong (1794), it has blocked the Wei River and caused repeated breaches and floods.

sentences.zh: 今河流既分，不可使復合。

translations.literal: Now that the rivers have divided, they must not be allowed to reunite.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the rivers have divided, they must not be allowed to merge again.

sentences.zh: 議於樊馬坊上下距洹水最近處，及南岸衝決成溝，並築土壩，使二河分流，冀減漫溢之勢。」

translations.literal: It is proposed to build earthen dams at the points above and below Fanmafang nearest the Huan, and where the south bank was breached into a channel, so the two rivers may flow separately and the force of spreading flood be reduced.'
translations.idiomatic: We propose building earthen dams at the points above and below Fanmafang nearest the Huan, and where the south bank was breached into a channel, so the two rivers may flow separately and reduce the risk of spreading flood."

sentences.zh: 至四年春，積水消涸，地形顯露。

translations.literal: By the spring of the fourth year the standing water had drained away and the terrain was revealed.
translations.idiomatic: By the spring of the fourth year (1824) the floodwaters had receded and the terrain lay exposed.

sentences.zh: 田市之北，漫水與溝隔斷，不能引歸正河。

translations.literal: North of Tianshi, the floodwater was cut off from the channel and could not be led back to the main river.
translations.idiomatic: North of Tianshi, floodwater was cut off from the drainage channel and could not be returned to the main river.

sentences.zh: 乃就其上游龍家莊窪地抽溝啟放，复於內黃馬家窪開引河，添築田家營大壩，使溜勢南趨。

translations.literal: He therefore opened a drainage ditch at the depression of Longjiazhuang upstream and released the water; he also cut a diversion channel at Majiawa in Neihuang, added the great dam at Tianjiaying, and directed the current southward.
translations.idiomatic: He opened a drainage ditch at the depression upstream at Longjiazhuang, cut a diversion channel at Majiawa in Neihuang, and added the great dam at Tianjiaying to drive the current southward.

sentences.zh: 自是漳、衛合併之患遂息。

translations.literal: From this the trouble of the Zhang and Wei merging was ended.
translations.idiomatic: From that point the danger of the Zhang and Wei merging was ended.

sentences.zh: 虞城橫河、惠民溝，夏邑巴清河，永城減水溝，舊為豫東宣洩潦水要區，迭經黃河漫淤，濱河連歲被災，並疏濬之。

translations.literal: The Heng River at Yucheng, Huimin Ditch, the Baqing River at Xiayi, and the flood-relief ditch at Yongcheng were formerly key areas in eastern Henan for draining floodwater; repeatedly silted by Yellow River overflows, the river districts suffered disaster year after year—all were dredged.
translations.idiomatic: The Heng River at Yucheng, Huimin Ditch, the Baqing River at Xiayi, and the flood-relief ditch at Yongcheng had long been the main drainage channels of eastern Henan; repeatedly silted by Yellow River floods, the river districts suffered disaster year after year, and Zuluo had them all dredged.

sentences.zh: 初，河南、安徽治捻匪從重典，嗣部議有所減改。

translations.literal: At first Henan and Anhui treated Nian bandits under the severest statutes; later the ministry deliberated and made reductions and changes.
translations.idiomatic: At first Henan and Anhui had prosecuted Nian bandits under the severest statutes, but later the ministry revised the penalties downward.

sentences.zh: 祖洛疏言：「匪徒結捻，倡劫黨眾，一呼而集，其豫謀早在結捻之時。

translations.literal: Zuluo memorialized: 'When bandits form Nian associations and incite robbery, the crowd gathers at a shout; their premeditation lies already in the act of forming the association.
translations.idiomatic: Zuluo memorialized: "When bandits form Nian associations and incite robbery, a crowd gathers at a single call; their conspiracy begins the moment they form the association.

sentences.zh: 新例以是否豫謀分別輕重，諸多窒礙，請復舊例。」

translations.literal: The new regulations distinguish severity by whether there was premeditation, which creates many obstacles; I request restoration of the old regulations.'
translations.idiomatic: The new regulations distinguish severity by whether conspiracy can be proved, which creates many obstacles in practice; I ask that the old regulations be restored."

sentences.zh: 並論匪徒拒捕及捕人治罪各條。

translations.literal: He also discussed the various articles on bandits resisting arrest and on punishing those who make arrests.
translations.idiomatic: He also addressed the articles governing bandits who resist arrest and the punishment of arresting officers.

sentences.zh: 又言：「獲盜究出舊案，免究從前失察處分。

translations.literal: He further said: 'When captured bandits reveal old cases, officials shall be exempted from prior disciplinary penalties for failure to detect them.
translations.idiomatic: He further proposed: "When captured bandits reveal old cases, officials should be exempted from prior penalties for failure to detect them.

sentences.zh: 請遵嘉慶間諭旨，俾除瞻顧。」

translations.literal: I request compliance with the edicts of the Jiaqing period so that scruples may be removed.'
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the edicts of the Jiaqing period be followed so that officials need no longer hold back out of fear of punishment."

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: All was approved.
translations.idiomatic: All was approved.

sentences.zh: 七年，丁母憂，服闋，署工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he observed mourning for his mother; when mourning ended he served as acting vice minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1827) he went into mourning for his mother; when the mourning period ended he served as acting vice minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 尋署湖南巡撫，調江蘇。

translations.literal: Soon he acted as governor of Hunan and was transferred to Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He soon served as acting governor of Hunan and was transferred to Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 十二年，擢閩浙總督。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was promoted to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Daoguang (1832) he was appointed governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 命查辦浙江鹽務，嚴定裁汰浮費章程，下部議行。

translations.literal: He was ordered to investigate Zhejiang salt administration, strictly fix regulations for cutting superfluous expenses, and the ministry deliberated and carried them out.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to investigate Zhejiang salt administration and draw up strict regulations for cutting superfluous expenses; the ministry approved and implemented them.

sentences.zh: 台灣奸民張丙、陳辦等倡亂，命將軍瑚松額督兵進剿，祖洛專治後路軍需。

translations.literal: The scoundrels Zhang Bing, Chen Ban, and others in Taiwan raised a rebellion; General Husong'e was ordered to lead troops in suppression, while Zuluo was charged solely with rear-area supplies.
translations.idiomatic: When the ruffians Zhang Bing, Chen Ban, and others raised a rebellion in Taiwan, General Husong'e was ordered to lead the campaign while Zuluo was charged with rear-area logistics.

sentences.zh: 十三年，提督馬濟勝破賊，張丙等就擒，赴台灣籌辦善後事宜，劾戰守不力之都司週進龍等，褫黜有差。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Provincial Commander Ma Jisheng defeated the bandits and Zhang Bing and others were captured; Zuluo went to Taiwan to arrange postwar affairs, impeached Assistant Regional Commander Zhou Jinlong and others for ineffective offense and defense, and stripped or demoted them according to degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year (1833) Provincial Commander Ma Jisheng defeated the rebels and Zhang Bing was captured; Zuluo went to Taiwan to handle postwar affairs, impeached Assistant Regional Commander Zhou Jinlong and others for ineffective conduct in battle, and stripped or demoted them as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 改營製，增防守。

translations.literal: He reformed the garrison system and increased defenses.
translations.idiomatic: He reformed the garrison system and strengthened defenses.

sentences.zh: 優敘，賜花翎。

translations.literal: He received superior merit recording and was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: He received a superior merit citation and was awarded the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 疏陳福建吏治，略曰：「安民必先懲蠹，不可以回護瞻顧而曲縱奸惡。

translations.literal: He memorialized on Fujian official governance, saying in summary: 'To pacify the people one must first punish corruption; one cannot shield and indulge the wicked out of concern for consequences.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized on Fujian official governance, writing in summary: "To secure the people's welfare one must first punish corruption; officials must not shield the wicked out of fear of consequences.

sentences.zh: 閩省吏治無子惠之政，而務寬大之名，始因官之庸劣，釀成頑梗之風，今又因民之譸張，遂有疲難之勢。

translations.literal: Fujian governance has no policies that truly benefit the people, yet pursues a reputation for leniency; at first mediocre officials bred a stubborn popular temper, and now because the people exaggerate, there is a weary and difficult situation.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian governance offers no policies that truly benefit the people, yet pursues a reputation for leniency. Mediocre officials first bred a stubborn popular temper, and now popular exaggeration has made administration weary and difficult.

sentences.zh: 官曰民刁，民曰吏虐，互相傳播，漸失其真。

translations.literal: Officials say the people are crafty; the people say the clerks are cruel—each spreads the charge until the truth is lost.
translations.idiomatic: Officials call the people crafty; the people call the clerks cruel. Each side spreads its complaint until the truth is lost.

sentences.zh: 官不執法，幕不守法，因而愚民犯法，書役弄法，棍徒玩法。

translations.literal: When officials do not enforce the law and secretaries do not observe it, ignorant commoners break the law, clerks manipulate the law, and ruffians mock the law.
translations.idiomatic: When officials do not enforce the law and secretaries do not observe it, ignorant commoners break the law, clerks manipulate the law, and ruffians mock the law.

sentences.zh: 必先懲不執法之官，然後能治犯法、弄法、玩法之人。」

translations.literal: One must first punish officials who do not enforce the law, and only then can one govern those who break, manipulate, or mock the law.'
translations.idiomatic: One must first punish officials who fail to enforce the law; only then can one govern those who break, manipulate, or mock it."

sentences.zh: 於是連劾官吏不職者，略無假貸，吏治始肅。

translations.literal: Thereupon he impeached incompetent officials in succession, showing no leniency, and official governance began to be disciplined.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he impeached incompetent officials in succession without mercy, and official discipline was restored.

sentences.zh: 已革縣丞秦師韓京控提督馬濟勝矇奏邀功，並訐祖洛偏袒欺矇，命侍郎趙盛奎偕學攻張鱗按鞫，白其誣，師韓遣戍新疆。

translations.literal: The dismissed assistant magistrate Qin Shihan memorialized from the capital accusing Provincial Commander Ma Jisheng of deceiving the throne to claim merit, and also accusing Zuluo of partiality and deception; Vice Minister Zhao Shengkui and Education Commissioner Zhang Lin were ordered to investigate; his false charges were cleared and Shihan was banished to Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: The dismissed assistant magistrate Qin Shihan memorialized from the capital accusing Provincial Commander Ma Jisheng of deceiving the throne to claim merit and Zuluo of partiality and cover-up. Vice Minister Zhao Shengkui and Education Commissioner Zhang Lin were ordered to investigate; the charges proved false and Shihan was banished to Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 十五年，疏陳閩洋形勢，以漳州之南澳、銅山為籓籬，泉之廈門、金門為門戶，興化之海壇為右翼，閩安為省會咽喉，福寧之銅山為後戶。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he memorialized on the maritime situation of Fujian: Nan'ao and Tongshan of Zhangzhou were the outer barrier, Xiamen and Jinmen of Quanzhou the gateway, Haitan of Xinghua the right wing, Min'an the throat of the provincial capital, and Tongshan of Funing the rear gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year (1835) he memorialized on Fujian's maritime defenses: Nan'ao and Tongshan at Zhangzhou formed the outer barrier, Xiamen and Jinmen at Quanzhou the gateway, Haitan at Xinghua the right flank, Min'an the throat of the provincial capital, and Tongshan at Funing the rear gate.

sentences.zh: 巡緝守禦，全資寨城砲台。

translations.literal: Patrol and defense relied entirely on stockades, walled posts, and batteries.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol and coastal defense relied entirely on stockades, walled posts, and batteries.

sentences.zh: 就最要者四十四處，由官民捐貲修築。

translations.literal: At the forty-four most critical points, officials and people contributed funds for construction.
translations.idiomatic: At the forty-four most critical points, officials and private donors contributed funds for construction.

sentences.zh: 十六年，丁父憂去官，服闋，引疾不出。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he left office on mourning for his father; when mourning ended he pleaded illness and did not emerge.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year (1836) he left office to mourn his father; when the mourning period ended he pleaded illness and declined further appointment.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，卒，宣宗甚惜之，贈太子太保，諡簡敬。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he died; Emperor Xuanzong deeply regretted it, posthumously made him Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and gave the posthumous title Jianjing.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twenty-eighth year (1848). The Daoguang Emperor deeply regretted his loss, posthumously made him Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and gave him the posthumous title Jianjing.

sentences.zh: 馬濟勝，山東菏澤人。

translations.literal: Ma Jisheng was a man of Heze, Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Jisheng came from Heze in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 以武生入伍，從剿川、陝教匪，積功累擢江蘇撫標參將。

translations.literal: As a military licentiate he entered the ranks, followed campaigns against the sect rebels of Sichuan and Shaanxi, and through accumulated merit was promoted in succession to colonel of the Jiangsu provincial army.
translations.idiomatic: Entering service as a military licentiate, he fought against the White Lotus rebels in Sichuan and Shaanxi and rose through merit to colonel of the Jiangsu provincial army.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十八年，會剿山東教匪，擢河北鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Jiaqing he joined in suppressing the Shandong sect rebels and was promoted to regional commander of Hebei Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Jiaqing (1813) he joined the suppression of sect rebels in Shandong and was promoted to regional commander of Hebei Garrison.

sentences.zh: 道光初，擢浙江提督，調福建陸路提督。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Daoguang he was promoted to provincial commander of Zhejiang and transferred to land forces commander of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Daoguang reign he was promoted to provincial commander of Zhejiang and transferred to land forces commander of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 張丙等倡亂嘉義，台灣鎮總兵劉廷斌困守孤城。

translations.literal: Zhang Bing and others raised rebellion at Jiayi; Taiwan Garrison Commander Liu Tingbin was besieged in a lone city.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Bing and others rebelled at Jiayi, Taiwan Garrison Commander Liu Tingbin was besieged in an isolated city.

sentences.zh: 濟勝率兵二千渡海赴援，戰於嘉義城下，大破賊，追至蘋港尾，擒斬甚眾；

translations.literal: Jisheng led two thousand troops across the sea to relieve them, fought below Jiayi city, routed the bandits, pursued to Pinggangwei, and captured and killed many;
translations.idiomatic: Jisheng led two thousand troops across the strait to relieve the siege, routed the rebels below Jiayi city, pursued them to Pinggangwei, and killed or captured many;

sentences.zh: 進屯鹽水港，分兵搜剿，張丙及其悍黨先後就擒。

translations.literal: he advanced and encamped at Yanshui Harbor, divided troops to search and suppress, and Zhang Bing and his fierce followers were captured in succession.
translations.idiomatic: he advanced to Yanshui Harbor, divided his forces to hunt down the rebels, and Zhang Bing and his chief followers were captured in turn.

sentences.zh: 時命將軍瑚松額督師猶未至，詔褒成功迅速，賜雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: At the time General Husonge, ordered to command the army, had not yet arrived; an edict praised the swift success and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: General Husonge, who had been ordered to take command, had not yet arrived; an edict praised Jisheng's swift success and granted him the double-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 餘匪萬餘復來犯，俟其怠，擊之大潰，擒頭目賴滿等，追剿盡毀其巢，賊遂平。

translations.literal: More than ten thousand remaining bandits attacked again; he waited until they grew slack, struck them into great rout, captured the chieftain Lai Man and others, pursued and destroyed all their lairs, and the bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten thousand remaining rebels attacked again; he waited until they grew careless, routed them completely, captured the chieftain Lai Man and others, pursued them and destroyed all their hideouts, and the rebellion was pacified.

sentences.zh: 宣宗深嘉其謀勇，錫封二等男爵。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong deeply praised his strategy and courage and ennobled him as a second-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: The Daoguang Emperor deeply praised his strategy and courage and ennobled him as a second-rank baron.

sentences.zh: 又以馭兵安靖，御書「忠勇廉明」四字賜之。

translations.literal: Because he disciplined troops and kept the peace, the emperor personally wrote the four characters 'Loyal, Brave, Incorrupt, Clear-sighted' and bestowed them on him.
translations.idiomatic: Because he kept his troops disciplined and the region at peace, the emperor personally wrote the four characters "Loyal, Brave, Incorrupt, and Clear-sighted" and bestowed them on him.

sentences.zh: 召入覲，年逾七旬，猶壯健，溫詔褒獎，晉二等子爵，在御前侍衛上行走。

translations.literal: He was summoned for audience; though over seventy he was still vigorous; a warm edict praised him, promoted him to second-rank viscount, and appointed him to serve in the imperial guard before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned to audience, he was still vigorous though over seventy; a warm edict praised him, promoted him to second-rank viscount, and appointed him to serve in the imperial guard before the throne.

sentences.zh: 十六年，卒於官，贈太子太保，諡昭武，四子皆予官。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he died in office; he was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, given the posthumous title Zhaowu, and all four sons were granted offices.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office in the sixteenth year (1836). The court posthumously made him Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, gave him the posthumous title Zhaowu, and granted offices to all four of his sons.

sentences.zh: 裕泰，滿洲正紅旗人。

translations.literal: Yu Tai was a man of the Plain Red Banner of the Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Tai was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 由官學生考授內閣中書，遷侍讀。

translations.literal: From the Imperial Academy student he passed examination and was appointed a secretary in the Grand Secretariat, then promoted to reader.
translations.idiomatic: A graduate of the Imperial Academy, he passed examination and was appointed a secretary in the Grand Secretariat, then promoted to reader.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶末，出為四川成綿龍茂道，歷四川、湖南、安徽按察使，湖南、陝西、安徽布政使。

translations.literal: At the end of Jiaqing he went out as intendant of the Cheng-Mian-Long-Mao circuit of Sichuan, and served in succession as surveillance commissioner of Sichuan, Hunan, and Anhui, and as financial commissioner of Hunan, Shaanxi, and Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Jiaqing reign he was posted as intendant of the Cheng-Mian-Long-Mao circuit in Sichuan, then served as surveillance commissioner of Sichuan, Hunan, and Anhui and as financial commissioner of Hunan, Shaanxi, and Anhui in turn.

sentences.zh: 道光十一年，擢盛京刑部侍郎，調工部，兼管奉天府尹事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Daoguang he was promoted to vice minister of Punishments at Mukden, transferred to Works, and concurrently directed the affairs of the Fengtian prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Daoguang (1831) he was promoted to vice minister of Punishments at Mukden, transferred to Works, and given concurrent charge of the Fengtian metropolitan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 查勘科爾沁蒙旗荒地，奏禁私墾。

translations.literal: He inspected wasteland of the Khorchin Mongol banner and memorialized to forbid private cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: He inspected wasteland on the Khorchin Mongol banner and memorialized to forbid unauthorized cultivation.

sentences.zh: 十三年，召授刑部侍郎，尋出為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was summoned and appointed vice minister of Punishments, and soon went out as governor of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year (1833) he was recalled and appointed vice minister of Punishments, then soon sent out as governor of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 十六年，古州、黎平土匪起，擒其渠徐玉貴等誅之。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year bandits rose at Guzhou and Liping; their leader Xu Yugui and others were captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year (1836) bandits rose at Guzhou and Liping; their leader Xu Yugui and others were captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 調湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: He was transferred to governor of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to governor of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 鎮筸標兵滋事，劾總兵向遵化、辰沅道常慶不職，罷之。

translations.literal: The garrison troops of Zhenqian made trouble; he impeached Regional Commander Xiang Zunhua and Circuit Intendant Chang Qing for incompetence and dismissed them.
translations.idiomatic: When garrison troops at Zhenqian mutinied, he impeached Regional Commander Xiang Zunhua and Circuit Intendant Chang Qing for incompetence and dismissed them.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「苗疆屯田，嘉慶中道員傅鼐所經營，寓兵於農，籌邊良策。

translations.literal: He memorialized: 'The military colonies of the Miao frontier were managed in Jiaqing by Circuit Intendant Fu Nai—soldiers settled among farmers—a fine strategy for frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "The military colonies on the Miao frontier were established in the Jiaqing period by Circuit Intendant Fu Nai, who settled soldiers among farmers—a sound strategy for frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 治安日久，諸弊叢生。

translations.literal: After long peace many abuses have sprung up.
translations.idiomatic: After long peace many abuses have sprung up.

sentences.zh: 今鎮筸標兵因借餉倡亂，苗人遂生觀望。

translations.literal: Now the Zhenqian garrison troops have stirred trouble over borrowed pay, and the Miao people have begun to watch and wait.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Zhenqian garrison has mutinied over borrowed pay, and the Miao people have begun to watch and wait.

sentences.zh: 重以苗官苛刻，屯長侵欺，後患堪虞。

translations.literal: Compounded by harsh Miao officials and colony headmen who encroach and cheat, future trouble is to be feared.
translations.idiomatic: Compounded by harsh Miao officials and colony headmen who extort and cheat, the risk of future trouble is grave.

sentences.zh: 急應清釐損益，妥定章程，俾將弁兵練咸知經費有常，絕其覬覦，仍責成鎮道實力整飭，恩威並行。」

translations.literal: It is urgent to clear accounts, weigh gains and losses, and fix sound regulations so that officers and soldiers all know funds are fixed and covetousness is cut off; still hold the regional commander and circuit intendant responsible for real discipline, combining grace and severity.'
translations.idiomatic: We must urgently clear the accounts, weigh what should be kept or cut, and fix sound regulations so that officers and soldiers know funds are fixed and temptation is removed; the regional commander and circuit intendant must still be held responsible for real discipline, combining leniency and severity."

sentences.zh: 尋議定苗疆兵勇不准客民充補，預借銀穀限以定制，拔補備弁屯長，嚴絕苞苴。

translations.literal: Soon it was decided that Miao frontier soldiers might not be filled by outsiders, advance loans of silver and grain were limited to fixed amounts, selection and replacement of officers and colony headmen was regulated, and bribery was strictly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations were soon fixed: frontier soldiers could not be recruited from outsiders, advance loans of silver and grain were capped, selection of officers and colony headmen was regulated, and bribery was strictly forbidden.

sentences.zh: 辰沅道缺，以湖南知府題升。

translations.literal: The Chen-Yuan circuit post was to be filled by nomination and promotion from Hunan prefects.
translations.idiomatic: The Chen-Yuan circuit post was to be filled by promotion from among Hunan prefects.

sentences.zh: 並如所議行。

translations.literal: All was carried out as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: All was implemented as proposed.

sentences.zh: 十七年，調江西，復調湖南。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to Jiangxi, then again to Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year (1837) he was transferred to Jiangxi, then back to Hunan.

sentences.zh: 二十年，擢湖廣總督。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was promoted to governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of Daoguang (1840) he was appointed governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，湖北崇陽逆匪鍾人傑作亂，踞縣城，陷通城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the rebel Zhong Renjie of Chongyang, Hubei, raised rebellion, seized the county seat, and captured Tongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year (1841) the rebel Zhong Renjie of Chongyang in Hubei seized the county seat and captured Tongcheng.

sentences.zh: 裕泰馳駐咸寧，檄按察使郭熊飛率都司玉貴等進剿。

translations.literal: Yu Tai hastened to station at Xianning and ordered Surveillance Commissioner Guo Xiongfei to lead Colonel Yugui and others in advance suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Tai hastened to Xianning and ordered Surveillance Commissioner Guo Xiongfei to lead Colonel Yugui and others in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 崇陽在萬山中，賊盡塞孔道，築砦抗拒，選精銳出賊後夾攻，分股犯蒲圻，連為官軍所敗，踞崇陽西嶺為負嵎計。

translations.literal: Chongyang lies among myriad mountains; the bandits blocked all passes, built stockades to resist, chose elite troops to strike from behind in pincer attack, sent detachments to raid Puqi and were repeatedly defeated by government troops, and held the western ridge of Chongyang in a cornered stand.
translations.idiomatic: Chongyang lies deep in the mountains; the rebels blocked every pass, built stockades to resist, and sent elite troops to attack from the rear while detachments raided Puqi. Repeatedly defeated by government forces, they held the western ridge of Chongyang in a last stand.

sentences.zh: 提督劉允孝迭敗之石盤山、黑橋，進毀其巢，擒人傑及其黨陳寶銘、汪敦族等。

translations.literal: Naval Commander Liu Yunxiao defeated them repeatedly at Shipan Mountain and Heiqiao, advanced and destroyed their lair, and captured Renjie and his followers Chen Baoming, Wang Dunzu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial Commander Liu Yunxiao defeated them repeatedly at Shipan Mountain and Heiqiao, advanced and destroyed their lair, and captured Renjie along with Chen Baoming, Wang Dunzu, and other followers.

sentences.zh: 尋复通城，盡俘其孥。

translations.literal: Soon Tongcheng was recovered and all their families were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Tongcheng was soon recovered and the rebels' families were all taken captive.

sentences.zh: 事平，加太子太保，賜雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: When order was restored he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and awarded the double-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 時英吉利兵由海入江，詔募勇習水戰。

translations.literal: At the time English troops entered the Yangzi from the sea; an edict ordered recruitment of braves trained in naval combat.
translations.idiomatic: At the time British forces were advancing up the Yangzi from the sea; an edict ordered the recruitment of militia trained in naval combat.

sentences.zh: 裕泰仿粵艇造大船六、快船四，簡漢陽水師，每船百人，按旬操練。

translations.literal: Yu Tai modeled Guangdong war junks to build six large ships and four fast boats, selected Hanyang naval troops, put a hundred men on each ship, and drilled them every ten days.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Tai modeled Guangdong war junks to build six large ships and four fast boats, selected naval troops from Hanyang, manned each vessel with a hundred men, and drilled them every ten days.

sentences.zh: 裁舊有巡船，以節經費。

translations.literal: He cut the old patrol boats to economize expenses.
translations.idiomatic: He eliminated the old patrol boats to save funds.

sentences.zh: 荊州駐防每出營滋事，奏請飭地方官拘拿，報將軍秉公嚴懲。

translations.literal: The Jingzhou garrison frequently left camp to make trouble; he memorialized ordering local officials to arrest them and report to the regional commander for impartial severe punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison troops at Jingzhou frequently left camp to make trouble; he memorialized that local officials should arrest them and report to the regional commander for impartial punishment.

sentences.zh: 乾州苗竄擾，剿撫解散。

translations.literal: Miao of Qianzhou raided and harassed; he suppressed and pacified them until they dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: When Miao from Qianzhou raided the borderlands, he suppressed and pacified them until they dispersed.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，李沅發倡亂新寧，踞城戕官。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Li Yuanfa raised rebellion at Xinning, seized the city, and killed officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang (1849) Li Yuanfa rebelled at Xinning, seized the city, and killed the officials.

sentences.zh: 巡撫馮德馨、提督英俊往剿，复縣城。

translations.literal: Governor Feng Dexin and Provincial Commander Yingjun went to suppress them and recovered the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Feng Dexin and Provincial Commander Yingjun marched to suppress them and recovered the county seat.

sentences.zh: 妄傳沅發已死，而賊竄山中，勾結黔、粵交界伏莽，勢益蔓延。

translations.literal: It was falsely reported that Yuanfa was dead, but the bandits fled into the mountains, linked with hidden ruffians on the Guizhou-Guangdong border, and their power spread further.
translations.idiomatic: A false report claimed Yuanfa was dead, but the rebels fled into the mountains, linked with bandits hidden on the Guizhou-Guangdong border, and their strength spread further.

sentences.zh: 馮德馨逮治，專任裕泰往督師，與黔、粵諸軍合擊，數捷。

translations.literal: Feng Dexin was arrested and punished; Yu Tai alone was charged to command the army, joined with Guizhou and Guangdong forces in combined attack, and won several victories.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Dexin was arrested and punished; Yu Tai alone was placed in command, joined forces from Guizhou and Guangdong, and won several victories.

sentences.zh: 三十年春，搜剿山內，擒殲多名。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirtieth year he searched and suppressed within the mountains and captured and killed many.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirtieth year (1850) he swept the mountains and killed or captured many rebels.

sentences.zh: 賊竄永福草奚塘，四面抄圍，漸窮蹙。

translations.literal: The bandits fled to Caoxitang at Yongfu; surrounded on four sides, they were gradually cornered.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled to Caoxitang at Yongfu; surrounded on all sides, they were gradually cornered.

sentences.zh: 裕泰度賊不南趨廣西全州，即入新寧瑤峒，令提督向榮由武岡進屯廣西懷遠，遇賊擊破之。

translations.literal: Yu Tai judged that if the bandits did not flee south toward Quanzhou in Guangxi they would enter the Yao ravines of Xinning; he ordered Provincial Commander Xiang Rong to advance from Wugang and encamp at Huaiyuan in Guangxi, where he met the bandits and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Tai judged that if the rebels did not flee south toward Quanzhou in Guangxi they would enter the Yao ravines of Xinning; he ordered Provincial Commander Xiang Rong to advance from Wugang and encamp at Huaiyuan in Guangxi, where he met and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 賊退踞金峰嶺，分三路進擊於深箐陡石間，斬獲殆盡，沅發就擒，晉太子太傅。

translations.literal: The bandits retreated to hold Jinfeng Ridge; advancing on three routes through deep ravines and steep rocks, government troops killed and captured nearly all; Yuanfa was captured and Yu Tai was promoted to Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels retreated to Jinfeng Ridge; government forces advanced on three routes through deep ravines and steep rocks, killed or captured nearly all of them, and took Yuanfa alive; Yu Tai was promoted to Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 尋調閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，調陝甘，入覲，卒，優詔以尚書例賜卹，諡莊毅。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng he was transferred to Shaanxi-Gansu, came to audience, and died; a favorable edict granted funeral honors at ministerial rank and the posthumous title Zhuangyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng (1851) he was transferred to Shaanxi-Gansu, came to the capital for audience, and died; the court granted funeral honors at ministerial rank and the posthumous title Zhuangyi.

sentences.zh: 子長善，廣州將軍；

translations.literal: His son Changshan was General of Guangzhou;
translations.idiomatic: His son Changshan became General of Guangzhou;

sentences.zh: 長敘，侍郎。

translations.literal: Changxu, vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: Changxu, vice minister.

sentences.zh: 賀長齡，字耦耕，湖南善化人，原籍浙江會稽。

translations.literal: He Zhangling, styled Ougeng, was a man of Shanhua, Hunan, with original domicile in Kuaiji, Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He Zhangling, whose style was Ougeng, came from Shanhua in Hunan, though his ancestral home was Kuaiji in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 高祖上振，官湖南司獄，卹囚有隱德，貧未能歸，遂家湖南。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Shangzhen served as jail warden of Hunan; he showed hidden virtue in pitying prisoners, was too poor to return home, and so the family settled in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Shangzhen had served as jail warden in Hunan; known for quietly showing mercy to prisoners, he was too poor to return home and the family settled in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 長齡，嘉慶十三年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，遷贊善。

translations.literal: Zhangling, in the thirteenth year of Jiaqing became a jinshi, was chosen as a Hanlin bachelor, appointed reviser, and promoted to tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangling passed the jinshi examination in the thirteenth year of Jiaqing (1808), entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, was appointed reviser, and rose to tutor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，出為江西南昌知府。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang he went out as prefect of Nanchang, Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daoguang (1821) he was appointed prefect of Nanchang in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 歷山東兗沂曹濟道、江蘇按察使，就遷布政使，佐巡撫陶澍創行海運。

translations.literal: He served as intendant of the Yan-Yi-Cao-Ji circuit of Shandong and surveillance commissioner of Jiangsu, was promoted in place to financial commissioner, and assisted Governor Tao Shu in inaugurating sea transport.
translations.idiomatic: He served as intendant of the Yan-Yi-Cao-Ji circuit in Shandong and surveillance commissioner of Jiangsu, was promoted on the spot to financial commissioner, and assisted Governor Tao Shu in establishing grain transport by sea.

sentences.zh: 調山東。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 七年，署巡撫。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he acted as governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Daoguang (1827) he served as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 臨清州教匪馬進忠為逆伏誅，復有揭帖偽立名號，刻期舉事，臚列旁州縣民名數百。

translations.literal: The sect bandit Ma Jinzhong of Linqing was executed as a traitor; afterward placards falsely set up a name and title, fixed a date for action, and listed hundreds of commoners' names from neighboring prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: The sect rebel Ma Jinzhong of Linqing had been executed for treason; afterward placards appeared falsely proclaiming a rebel title, fixing a date for action, and listing hundreds of names from neighboring counties.

sentences.zh: 長齡曰：「謀不軌詎以姓名月日告？

translations.literal: Zhangling said: 'Would conspirators against the throne announce their names and the month and day?
